brief: Hoo! You made it to the end of the Reading Road! Build a Hall of Pillars for the 7 Pillars of Virtue, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read what each character did and tap the pillar it shows. Then finish two sentences about your year.
extra: Add a Book - Joy. Say the most joyful part of your reading year.
step1: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put the pillars in a row. Put one book at the foot of each pillar.
step4: Stand by one pillar and say this out loud. This pillar is… A character who showed it this year is…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
